study type: Mixed-methods evaluation of an educational intervention (pre- and post-course questionnaires and post-course interviews)
exposure: Art & Craft course (Advanced Rotational Techniques and safe Caesarean biRth at Advanced/Full dilation Training)
outcome: Confidence levels in performing vaginal examination
Confidence levels in ultrasound assessment of fetal position
Confidence levels in Kielland's rotational forceps
Confidence levels in disimpaction of the fetal head during second stage caesarean
cohort: 32 senior Obstetrics trainees attended the course, with 28 questionnaires available for analysis.
finding: Confidence levels of senior Obstetrics trainees significantly increased across all assessed domains (vaginal examination, ultrasound for fetal position, rotational ventouse, manual rotation, disimpaction, and Kielland's rotational forceps) after attending the Art & Craft course.
mod_finding: Confidence in performing techniques for rotational vaginal birth (ventouse, manual rotation, Kielland's forceps) and disimpaction of the fetal head during second stage Caesarean section significantly increased after the course.
